verdict.rationale: v0 explicitly claims the API gives 'programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities' including chat, project management, and deployment (v0-docs-4), and the SDK shows working examples of chat creation and streaming (v0-gh-1, v0-gh-2) plus GitHub import support in the API docs (v0-docs-37, v0-docs-25, v0-docs-42). However, many UI-only features documented elsewhere (Fix Build/Fix CI diagnostics, branch/PR/CI management, command palette, iOS app, custom hooks) are never shown as exposed through the API, so true UI-API parity is asserted but not concretely demonstrated across the full feature set. Missing for 10: API-level examples of PR/CI/branch management, deployment auto-fix, and project settings management to substantiate the 'everything' claim, plus independent confirmation of parity.
